scope: Exact AdS vacuum scalar preflight; actual charged retarded transfer remains open

primary_sources.reading_scope: Introduction equations (1)-(4); scalar radial operator and Theorem 3.2 case (iv), printed pp. 34-38. Not a complete audit of every field sector.
primary_sources.use: Prior result: scalar AdS spatial operators with nu^2<0 and all their self-adjoint extensions are unbounded below. The new note independently proves the benchmark compact-test estimate; it does not claim the general BF result as new.

primary_sources.reading_scope: Abstract and section IV discussions of higher-derivative runaway solutions, physical validity and reduction of order. No use of its ANEC conclusion as a theorem for this charged exterior.
primary_sources.use: Context for the distinction between full higher-derivative dynamics and an order-reduced effective prescription. No such prescription is adopted here.

closest_comparator: Known Breitenlohner-Freedman/Ishibashi-Wald scalar AdS instability. Contribution is the retained coefficient identification, conformal vacuum metric lift and explicit benchmark compact witness, not a new general BF theorem.
